# ChromaDB 1.5.9 is the latest release and no patched version exists for these
# advisories as of 2026-10-26. Vellum uses only embedded PersistentClient and
# EphemeralClient instances; it does not expose Chroma's authenticated HTTP,
# tenant-authorization, remote-model, or trust_remote_code paths. Do not add a
# Chroma server or remote client while these exceptions remain active.
# Reviewed upstream release metadata and the following advisories; all report
# no fixed version. Rechecked PyPI and all four GitHub advisories on 2026-10-26;
# the latest release remains 1.5.9 and all first_patched_version fields are null.
# Source inspection still finds only embedded PersistentClient/EphemeralClient
# construction, with no Chroma HTTP client, server, or trust_remote_code use.
# This is a time-bounded review of the existing four exceptions, not a new audit
# of all currently installed packages. Recheck by expiry or when usage changes.
